checkpoints.quote: *Error! To keep using mobile app, please log in to Online Banking and fill the customer's questionnaire.*
checkpoints.reason: The analysis quotes the exact error text with the "Error!" heading, matching the screenshot wording.
The analysis never mentions the OK button, the inability to dismiss the dialog, or the "Enter your Online Banking credentials" login screen behind it.
The analysis does not mention the username TESTRELAXLUX4 or the empty password field at all.
The analysis never notes that the password is empty or infers that the block occurs before any authentication attempt.
The analysis does not mention that the issue reproduces on the team's own test account, so it is not specific to the reporting customer.

checkpoints.quote: The ticket does not clarify whether the app is supposed to block login entirely or simply warn the user about required steps.
checkpoints.reason: The substance of the unanswered question (block vs. warn) is captured, but it is not attributed to Tom Becker's comment.

checkpoints.quote: Assign owner: Assign a team member to investigate the login flow dependencies with Online Banking to confirm whether the app's logic matches user expectations.
checkpoints.reason: Assigning the ticket is mentioned, but confirming with the business/product owner whether blocking is intended and giving support an answer for the stuck customer are not specifically called out.
The analysis only quotes the error text that matches the screenshot and does not invent any additional error codes, session-expired messages, or on-screen wording.
The analysis consistently states the customer is blocked and cannot log in; it does not claim the dialog can be dismissed or that a password was entered and rejected.

unsupported_claims.quote: This conflict is highlighted by the error message's implication that login to Online Banking is mandatory (even though the user may not have it).
unsupported_claims.reason: The ticket never states or implies that the customer does not have an Online Banking account; this parenthetical is an invented detail.

unsupported_claims.quote: the customer is not logged in to Online Banking (since the app requires it to proceed)
unsupported_claims.reason: The ticket does not state the customer's Online Banking login status; this is presented as fact rather than as an inference from the error message.
